test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is INCORRECT about line standard?

options.text: More accurate due to line thickness
Quick measurements over a wide range
Used to measure the distance between two engraved lines

solution:
The correct answer is __More accurate due to line thickness****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Line standards__ are used to measure distances between two engraved lines.
 
• These standards are quick to use for measurements over a wide range.
 
• They are subject to parallax error when viewed at an angle.
 
• Line thickness can affect the accuracy of the measurement, making them less precise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **End standards:**
 
 
• Used for measuring the distance between flat, parallel faces.
 
• They offer higher accuracy compared to line standards.
 
 
 
• **Gauge Blocks:**
 
 
• Gauge blocks are precision tools used as reference standards for measurement.
 
• They are used in calibration and are highly accurate.
